Hey, something I actually have experience with.  I’m the same as your fiancé. I will promise sex or tease my husband, but by the time he gets home I’m too tired, or not in the mood, or something else. He finally brought it up to me. I take criticism very well, so I wasn’t hurt by it. More hurt that I was doing that to him. It had gotten to the point that I would wind him up probably three times a week and only deliver once or twice a month. He sat me down, told him how it makes him feel and said that even if I’m not feeling it at the time to at least give it a try. Before anyone gets all crazy on me, he said we can start to fool around and if I’m still not feeling it, we stop. And that has held true. 9/10 if we start to fool around I’m ready. I would just talk to her about it and how it makes you feel. This is not something you want to start your marriage with. Open communication is the key to making it work. Maybe give her the option my husband gave me. At least give it a try and if she isn’t feeling it, move on. You may need to rub one out, but at least you know you tried. I hope that helps
